name: Subtitle Writer
desc: Puts subtitles made elsewhere (Whisper, translations) next to the videos, for Plex.
about: The one service allowed to write into the media library. Machines that make subtitles (Whisper speech-to-text on the PC, translated copies) hand them over through MCP or a small API; it writes them next to the video as <video>.<label>.<lang>.srt so Plex offers them as subtitle tracks. It only writes .srt files, only next to videos that exist, and only ever replaces or removes files it wrote itself.
